Exact adaptive test for matched pairs (Brown + Noether)

Source: R/rosenbaum-pairs.R
riposte_adaptive_test.Rd

Exact adaptive test for matched pairs (Brown + Noether)

Usage

riposte_adaptive_test(y, gamma = 1, alpha = 0.05, lambda = c(1/3, 2/3))

Arguments

y

matched-pair differences (treated minus control). Zero differences are dropped. Ties among |y| are broken by order (ties.method = "first") with a warning, because the paper assumes untied ranks.

gamma

sensitivity parameter.

alpha

level.

lambda

the two band fractions 0 < lambda[1] < lambda[2] <= 1 (default c(1/3, 2/3)).

Value

a list with reject, B1, T, kB, kT, I1, I2, size.

References

Rosenbaum, P. R. (2012) An exact adaptive test with superior design sensitivity in an observational study of treatments for ovarian cancer. Annals of Applied Statistics 6(1), 83-105.
